name: Ding Yanqian
quote: It's been a truly special experience working with Jasmine as my career coach. Our sessions together came at a turning point in my journey: when I was navigating between the excitement and uncertainty of academia and exploring what might lie beyond it. Jasmine has an exceptional way of guiding through deep reflection with gentleness, precision, and curiosity. She doesn't simply give answers; she asks the kind of questions that go straight to the heart of things: questions that help you uncover your own truth. Through our work, I've gained clarity about my values, my direction, and how to reconnect with myself when I feel lost. What I appreciated most is how safe and open our space always felt. Her coaching doesn't just address career choices; it reaches much deeper, connecting mind, heart, and body in a way that makes change truly sustainable. I'm deeply grateful for her guidance and warmth. The insights and framework I built with her will stay with me far beyond this coaching journey.
